ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass With Fake DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Attempts to load dismcore.dll after dropping it Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\dism\\\.exe$") AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dismcore\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Dism\\dismcore\.dll")
